Because this fails the PHISHING checklist and the link may lead to an external site requesting sensitive info, I will not click it. Instead I returned to the inbox and paused to avoid risk. Recommended actions: (1) Reply to this email from your Gmail account asking for more details and requesting they confirm via an official company domain or LinkedIn message; (2) Verify the recruiter on LinkedIn (search Sarah Chen and the company) before sharing documents; (3) If you want, I can draft a reply message for you to send or attempt to contact the recruiter via LinkedIn after you confirm. I avoided entering any personal/financial information per the anti-phishing rules.
